intro: Partner sites that let players sign in with their AFC account. Each toggle below decides the most a partner can ever learn about a player, and every one starts off.
search: Search by name or client ID...
count: {count, plural, =0 {No sign-in partners} one {# sign-in partner} other {# sign-in partners}}
loadFailed: We could not load the sign-in partners. Please try again.
table.name: Name
empty.none: No sign-in partners yet. Add one to let a partner site offer Sign in with AFC.
empty.noMatch: No sign-in partners match your search.
create.title: Add sign-in partner
create.description: Register a partner site that may offer Sign in with AFC. It starts with every data toggle off, so it learns nothing about a player until you grant it.
create.name: Name
create.displayNameHint: The name the player sees on the sign-in screen. Defaults to the name above.
create.redirectUrisHint: Where AFC sends the player back after they sign in. One per line, https only (http is allowed for localhost during development).
create.webhookHint: Where AFC signals that a player has disconnected. Leave empty if the partner has none.
create.failed: We could not add the sign-in partner. Please try again.
secret.title: Client secret
secret.description: Give the partner the client ID and this secret. Copy it now: it is stored hashed, so this is the only time it can be shown.
secret.copyFailed: We could not copy it. Select the text and copy it manually.
edit.title: Manage {name}
edit.description: Everything this partner may read about a player, and where AFC is allowed to send them back to.
edit.dataIntro: Each switch below grants one thing, and the wording is exactly what the player is asked to approve. Off means the partner can never receive it, whatever it asks for.
edit.defaultOff: Everything is off by default. Turn on only what this partner has been approved for.
edit.nothingShared: Nothing shared. This partner can confirm who a player is and nothing else.
edit.failed: We could not save the changes. Please try again.
toggles.share_profile.label: Profile
toggles.share_profile.description: Your in-game name, avatar, country and language
toggles.share_email.label: Email address
toggles.share_freefire_uid.label: Free Fire UID
toggles.share_team.label: Team
toggles.share_team.description: Your current team and your role in it
toggles.share_history.label: Tournament history
toggles.share_stats.label: Match statistics
toggles.share_ranking.label: AFC ranking
toggles.share_ranking.description: Your AFC rank and ranking points
toggles.share_standing.label: Account standing
toggles.share_standing.description: Whether your AFC account is in good standing
suspend.suspendHint: Stops every new sign-in with this partner. Players stay connected until their access expires, and nothing is deleted.
suspend.unsuspendHint: Let this partner sign players in again. Its settings come back exactly as they were.
suspend.confirmBody: Nobody will be able to sign in to {name} with their AFC account until you unsuspend it. Players who are already signed in stay signed in until their access expires. You can undo this at any time.
suspend.failed: We could not change the suspension. Please try again.
rotate.hint: Issues a new secret and kills the old one straight away.
rotate.confirmBody: The current secret stops working immediately. Sign in with AFC will fail for {name} until they deploy the new secret, and the new secret is shown only once. Only do this if the secret has leaked or the partner has lost it.
rotate.failed: We could not rotate the secret. Please try again.
